/usr/bin/env sh -c command -v ip
/usr/bin/env sh -c command -v nft
/usr/bin/env sh -c command -v tc
/usr/bin/env sh -c command -v logger
ip -4 -br addr show dev eth9
ip -4 -br addr show dev eth1
ip -4 -br addr show dev eth0
mkdir -p /run/cfab
ip link show eth0
ip link set eth0 up
ip link show eth1
ip link set eth1 up
ip link show eth9
ip link set eth9 up
/usr/bin/env sh -c command -v ethtool
ethtool -i eth9
ethtool -i eth1
ethtool -i eth0
write /run/cfab/wire-drivers
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/all/ignore_routes_with_linkdown
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/all/send_redirects
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/default/send_redirects
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/default/forwarding
ip link show cfab-id99
ip link show cfab-id99
ip link add cfab-id99 type veth peer name cfab-id99-peer
ip addr replace 10.99.0.1/32 dev cfab-id99
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-id99/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-id99/send_redirects
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-id99-peer/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-id99-peer/send_redirects

ip link set cfab-id99 up
ip route replace unreachable 10.99.0.0/16

ip link show cfab-id199
ip link add cfab-id199 type veth peer name cfab-id199-peer

ip link show cfab-gw249

ip link show cfab-gw249-a

ip link set cfab-gw249-c up
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-gw249-c/forwarding
ip link set cfab-gw249 type bond primary cfab-gw249-c primary_reselect always
ip addr replace 192.168.249.1/24 dev cfab-gw249
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-gw249/arp_ignore
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-gw249/rp_filter
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-gw249/send_redirects
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-gw249/forwarding
ip link set cfab-gw249 up
ip route replace default via 192.168.249.254 dev cfab-gw249 table 249 proto 205
ip link show cfab-st-fb
ip link add cfab-st-fb type bond mode active-backup miimon 100 num_grat_arp 3 updelay 500 fail_over_mac none
ip link show cfab-st-fb-a
ip link show cfab-st-fb-a

ip addr replace 10.99.9.1/24 dev cfab-st-fb
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-st-fb/arp_ignore
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-st-fb/rp_filter

ip link show cfab-cl-fb-c

write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-cl-fb-c/forwarding

ip addr replace 10.199.9.1/24 dev cfab-cl-fb
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-cl-fb/arp_ignore
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-cl-fb/rp_filter
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-cl-fb/send_redirects
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-cl-fb/forwarding
ip link set cfab-cl-fb up
ip link show cfab-mg-fb
ip link add cfab-mg-fb type bond mode active-backup miimon 100 num_grat_arp 3 updelay 500 fail_over_mac none
ip link show cfab-mg-fb-a
ip link show cfab-mg-fb-a

ip link set cfab-mg-fb-a master cfab-mg-fb
ip link set cfab-mg-fb-a up
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-mg-fb-a/forwarding
ip link show cfab-mg-fb-b

ip link show cfab-work-vms
ip link show cfab-work-vms
ip link add link primary name cfab-work-vms type vlan id 3 egress-qos-map 0:0 6:6
ip addr replace 192.168.20.2/24 dev cfab-work-vms
ip link set cfab-work-vms up
bridge -j vlan show dev primary
bridge vlan add dev primary vid 3 self
write /run/cfab/workload-self-vid
ip rule show pref 2000
ip rule add pref 2000 from 10.99.0.0/16 to 10.99.0.0/16 lookup main suppress_prefixlength 0
ip rule show pref 2000
ip rule add pref 2000 from 10.99.0.0/16 to 192.168.20.0/24 lookup main
ip rule show pref 2001
ip rule add pref 2001 from 10.99.0.0/16 lookup 99
ip rule show pref 2002
ip rule add pref 2002 from 10.99.0.0/16 unreachable
ip rule show pref 2000
ip rule add pref 2000 from 10.199.0.0/16 to 10.199.0.0/16 lookup main suppress_prefixlength 0
ip rule show pref 2001
ip rule add pref 2001 from 10.199.0.0/16 lookup 199
ip rule show pref 2002
ip rule add pref 2002 from 10.199.0.0/16 unreachable
ip rule show pref 2000
ip rule add pref 2000 from 10.249.0.0/16 to 10.249.0.0/16 lookup main suppress_prefixlength 0
ip rule show pref 2001
ip rule add pref 2001 from 10.249.0.0/16 lookup 249
ip rule show pref 2002
ip rule add pref 2002 from 10.249.0.0/16 unreachable
ip route show table main default
ip -4 -br addr show dev eth0
ip rule show pref 2099
ip rule show pref 2099
ip rule add pref 2099 from 192.168.10.1 iif lo lookup main
ip rule show pref 2100
ip rule add pref 2100 from all iif lo lookup main suppress_prefixlength 0
ip rule show pref 2101
ip rule add pref 2101 from all iif lo lookup 250
ip route replace default via 192.168.249.254 dev cfab-gw249 src 192.168.249.1 table 250 proto 206
ip -j neigh show dev cfab-work-vms
bridge -j fdb show br primary
write /run/cfab/policy.nft
nft -f /run/cfab/policy.nft
nft list chain inet cfab-fwd forward
nft -s list table inet cfab-fwd
write /run/cfab/policy.applied
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-st/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-st-bk/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-st-b2/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-cl/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-cl-bk/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-cl-b2/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-mg/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-mg-bk/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-mg-b2/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-gw249/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-st-fb/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-cl-fb/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-mg-fb/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/eth9/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/eth1/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/eth0/forwarding
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/cfab-work-vms/forwarding
iptables -S DOCKER-USER
write /run/cfab/workload-bridge.nft
nft -f /run/cfab/workload-bridge.nft
nft -s list table bridge cfab
write /run/cfab/workload-bridge.applied
write /run/cfab/workload-deferred
ip addr replace 192.168.20.254/24 dev cfab-work-vms
write /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/all/arp_ignore
write /run/cfab/mark.backend
/usr/bin/env sh -c command -v iptables-legacy
/usr/bin/env sh -c command -v iptables-legacy-save
iptables-legacy-save -t mangle
rm /run/cfab/mark.ipt
write /run/cfab/mark.nft
nft -f /run/cfab/mark.nft
nft -s list table inet cfab
write /run/cfab/mark.applied
tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root fq_codel
tc qdisc replace dev eth1 root fq_codel
tc qdisc replace dev eth9 root fq_codel
